Question: Assume: 1) no-inter player trading occurs, 2) there are no development cards left to draw, 3) in-hand VP cards count as points 4) the blue player has 2 consecutive turns. What is the maximum points the blue player can get by the end of two turn, given the player rolls a 8 in the first turn and 11 in the second turn? Return your answer in the following format: [prev_points: <number of points the player has before 2 turns>, new_points: <the number of points the player has after 2 turns>]
Rationale: According to the given game state, the Blue player begins the round with two settlements on the board and the following resources: 0 brick, 1 wool, 1 grain, 2 lumber, and 2 ore. The development cards include: year of plenty, and road building. The player also has the longest army card, with an army of 3 knights. After rolling an eight, the Blue player receives 1 additional brick. Currently the player has: 2points from settlements + 2 points from the largest kingdom = 4 points. To maximize points in these 2 round: turn 1: the player can first use the Road Building development card to place two roads. By extending the existing longest road—specifically by placing the new roads along the paths between the 11–12 hexes and the 12–6 hexes—the Blue player creates a continuous path long enough to claim the Longest Road special card, earning 2 victory points. With the remaining resources, the Blue player can then build a settlement at either the 9–11–12 intersection or the 12–6–3 intersection, gaining an additional point. In total, by strategically using the Road Building card, extending their path, and constructing a settlement, the Blue player can increase their score by up to 3 points this round, reaching a maximum of seven points overall. Turn 2: the player rolls 11 gaining 1 ore resource card. the player plays the development card: year of plenty and get 2 grain cards from the market resource pool. Using 2 grain resource cards and 3 ore resource cards to upgrade one of the settlements to a city (+1 point). Therefore the maximum points the player can get at the end of 2 turns is 8 points.
